about.title: About and AI use
about.lead: A plain list of how this prototype was made, and what it does with your answers.

rows.t: Story text was drafted with AI help, then reviewed and edited by the team.
Voice lines are made with ElevenLabs from team-approved text.
Characters and scenes are built in code by the team.
In this demo build, answers are read by written rules inside the app. A model API can be switched in later.
Data: anonymous session ID, stored in your browser only. Hosting provider may keep standard request logs.
What this prototype does not do: no claim that it improves learning.
